informal_statement: For every real \(\lambda\) and four-arc assembly, its auxiliary parametrized weighted perimeter equals the density integral against the canonical complete-frontier measure of its carrier.
reason: Source `FrontierPerimeter.lean:1794-1844`: The proof unfolds the canonical frontier measure, transports the integral, decomposes the exact frontier and evaluates its arc integrals; it does not infer geometry from a scalar sum.
